## TL;DR

Reshape the Angular web app to match iOS information architecture, then port the missing feature surfaces, then layer Midnight Emerald visuals last. Strategic choice is **Option C (IA-first, theme-later)** from the brainstorm, executed as a **10-stub epic** under the **hybrid Q1 model**: single-league main shell (Play / Team / League / Admin) plus a separate multi-league Search surface that retains the existing `selected-*` pages.

---

## Scope

### In scope (10 stubs from BRAINSTORM Phase 3, Option C)
1. Shell + nav rewrite
2. Search surface refresh
3. League surface split
4. Draft tab restructure
5. Landing hub
6. AI Review hub
7. Admin portal
8. Team Analyzer
9. Draft Order Proposal
10. Midnight Emerald visual sweep

### Out of scope
- Rebuilding the marketing landing page (`xomware-frontend` repo).
- Replacing the Sleeper REST integration with a third-party SDK.
- Angular Material / PrimeNG adoption — hand-rolled components only.
- Any backend work (Lambdas, Supabase schema, infra). All contracts already exist; changes belong in `xomper-back-end` / `xomper-infrastructure`.
- CloudWatch log tailing on the Admin → Logs surface (iOS stubs it; we mirror that — see Open Questions).
- `MockDraftEngine` port from iOS as part of stub 9 — view-only ships first; full engine deferred (see Risks).

---

## Sequencing

Each stub's slug is the folder name `/orchestrate` will create under `docs/features/web-ios-parity/`. Stub 10 is **explicitly last** per Option C's theme-deferral commitment.

1. **`s1-shell-nav-rewrite`** — Replace `ToolbarComponent` with `SidebarComponent` (desktop) + slide-out drawer (mobile) mirroring iOS `TrayDestination`; collapse `my-*` routes into flat `/league`, `/team`, `/profile`; land CSS custom-property tokens; kill the "My League" dropdown. _Foundation for every later stub — sidebar entries reference routes the later stubs build._ Covers iOS: `DrawerView.swift`, `TrayDestination.swift`, `AppRouter.swift`.
2. **`s2-search-surface-refresh`** — Rebuild `SearchComponent` to iOS's three-mode segmented control (User / League / Player) with paste-any-Sleeper-league-ID input; wire results into preserved `selected-*` pages. _Depends on stub 1 routing changes (`/search` registered, `selected-*` retained)._ Covers iOS: `SearchView.swift`, `SearchStore.swift`, `AppRoute.search`.
3. **`s3-league-surface-split`** — Split `LeagueComponent`'s mega `activeTab` into separate route components: Standings, Matchups, Playoffs, World Cup, Rulebook, Scoring, League Settings, Payouts, Rule Proposals. _Depends on stub 1 sidebar entries existing; unblocks stubs 4/9 which carve further from this surface._ Covers iOS: `StandingsView`, `MatchupsView`, `PlayoffBracketView`, `WorldCupView`, `RulesView`, `PayoutsView`.
4. **`s4-draft-tab-restructure`** — Lift `pages/draft-history` to per-year sub-tabs (Live / Mocks / Recap for current season, Picks / Recap for past). _Depends on stub 3 having vacated the Rules mega-tab pattern; sets the structural slot stub 9 plugs into._ Covers iOS: `DraftHistoryView.swift`.
5. **`s5-landing-hub`** — Build `LandingComponent` with 5 cards (Headline AI Report, Draft countdown, Announcements, Standings scroll bar, This-week matchups) + 2 new services (`ai-review.service`, `announcements.service`). _Depends on stub 1 routing `/` to landing; depends on stub 3 standings/matchups extraction for card data sources._ Covers iOS: `LandingView.swift`.
6. **`s6-ai-review-hub`** — Build `AIReviewListComponent` + `AIReviewDetailComponent`; extends the `ai-review.service` introduced in stub 5. _Depends on stub 5 for the service skeleton; depends on stub 1 for sidebar entry._ Covers iOS: `AIReviewView.swift`, `AIReviewDetailView.swift`.
7. **`s7-admin-portal`** — `AdminComponent` shell + 8 sub-screens in priority order (AI Review trigger → Test Email → Email Archive → Announcements CRUD → Tables → Audit → Cron → Logs deferred). Gates on Supabase `is_admin`. _Depends on stub 1 for admin section in sidebar; depends on stub 6 for `ai-review.service` reuse; depends on stub 5 for `announcements.service`._ Covers iOS: `AdminView.swift` + all `Features/Admin/*` sub-views.
8. **`s8-team-analyzer`** — Port `TeamAnalyzerView.swift` hexagon chart. _Depends on stub 1 for Team-section sidebar entry; independent of other feature stubs._ Covers iOS: `TeamAnalyzerView.swift`.
9. **`s9-draft-order-proposal`** — Build `DraftOrderComponent` view-only (proposal form + read-only mock display). Full `MockDraftEngine` port is **explicitly deferred** to a follow-up sub-stub. _Depends on stub 4's Draft restructure; depends on stub 3's Rule Proposals split (same proposal infra)._ Covers iOS: `DraftOrderView.swift`.
10. **`s10-midnight-emerald-sweep`** — Component-level visual port: dark gradient backgrounds, gold/red accent treatments, red `h2` headers, red dividers, typography pass. Tokens already exist from stub 1; this is the styling sweep. **Must be last** so feature PRs don't churn on visual review. _Depends on every prior stub being merged._ Covers iOS: `XomperColors.swift`, `XomperTheme.swift`.

| Stub | New web service(s) | Backend contract used | New backend work? |
|---|---|---|---|
| s1 Shell + nav | — | — | No |
| s2 Search | — (reuses `league.service`, `user.service`) | Sleeper API + Supabase | No |

| s4 Draft restructure | — for Live/Picks; deferred for Recap (uses ai-review service) | Lambda `GET /ai-reports/...` (stub 6) | No |
| s5 Landing | `ai-review.service` (new), `announcements.service` (new) | Lambda `GET /ai-reports/headline`, Supabase `league_announcements` | No |
| s6 AI Review hub | extends `ai-review.service` | Lambda `GET /ai-reports`, `GET /ai-reports/{id}` | No |
| s7 Admin portal | `admin.service`, `email-archive.service`, `tables.service`, `audit.service`, `cron.service`; extends `announcements.service` | Lambda `POST /ai-review/trigger`, `POST /email/test-send`, `POST /email/resend`; Supabase `email_archive`, `whitelisted_users`, `whitelisted_leagues`, `audit_log`, `cron_settings`, `league_announcements` | No |
| s8 Team Analyzer | — (Sleeper data already in `team.service`) | Sleeper API | No |
| s9 Draft Order Proposal | extends `rules.service` (proposals) | Supabase proposals tables | No |
| s10 Theme sweep | — | — | No |

## Risks

- **Phase 1 (stubs 1–4) interim looks "reorganized but stale".** The sidebar will reflect iOS IA before the new feature surfaces (Landing, AI Review, Admin) actually exist behind those entries. _Mitigation (locked):_ **`?newShell=1` query-param gate on `main`.** Each stub ships small to `main` behind the gate; production users continue to see the old toolbar until the default flips after stub 5 (Landing) merges. Why over a long-lived branch: smaller PRs, faster CI feedback, real-prod test path per stub, easy per-stub revert, no cumulative merge risk. Cost: routing layer carries the gate flag through Phase 1 — accepted.
- **Single-maintainer review.** No second pair of eyes per PR. _Mitigation:_ run `/ultrareview` per stub before opening the PR (also see Open Questions).
- **`MockDraftEngine` is heavyweight.** Stub 9 ships view-only. _Mitigation:_ plan calls this out explicitly; full engine port becomes its own follow-up stub (`s9b-mock-draft-engine`) or skipped indefinitely if web users don't need to author mocks.
- **Theme deferral.** Web stays visually off-brand during stubs 2–9. Accepted per Option C, but flag during user communication so it doesn't surprise.
- **`selected-*` retention adds surface area to test.** Q1 hybrid keeps `selected-profile`, `selected-league`, `selected-team` alive for Search results. Every stub touching `LeagueComponent` or `TeamComponent` must verify both `my` and `selected` modes still work. _Mitigation:_ each stub's plan includes a "verify selected-* mode" check.

---

## Success criteria (epic-level)

- Sidebar destinations and order match iOS `TrayDestination` exactly — Play / Team / League / Admin sections render the same entries `DrawerView.swift` renders.
- Every iOS drawer destination has a working web route (Admin → Logs excepted, mirroring iOS stub state).
- Search surface mirrors iOS shape: three-mode segmented control (User / League / Player) plus a free-form Sleeper league-ID input that opens a read-only league view.
- Admin section gates on Supabase `is_admin` the same way iOS does — non-admins do not see the section in the sidebar.
- Midnight Emerald palette is applied across the app: dark backgrounds, gold accents, red `h2` headers, red dividers — matching the iOS email templates and `XomperColors.swift`.

---

## Decisions (locked 2026-06-03)

- [x] **D-A: `/ultrareview` per stub** before each PR opens. Solo maintainer = no peer review; catching issues at stub boundary prevents compounding errors into later stubs. Stub plan templates must include an `/ultrareview` step before "open PR".
- [x] **D-B: Standalone-components migration → Phase 0 prerequisite PR** (split, not bundled). See Phase 0 checklist item.
- [x] **D-C: GitHub issues — one epic issue + 10 sub-issues** with `epic:web-ios-parity` label on each. Epic issue acts as the parent tracker; stub PRs use `Closes #<sub-issue>` and reference the epic in the body. Branch naming follows the project rule `<type>/<sub-issue-number>-<short-desc>`.
- [x] **D-D: Admin → Logs deferred** to mirror iOS stub state. CloudWatch tail not in v1. The Admin portal sub-screen list in stub 7 marks Logs as "placeholder card" only.
- [x] **D-E: `?newShell=1` query-param gate on `main`** during stubs 1–5. Each stub merges incrementally; default flips when stub 5 (Landing) lands. See Risks section for full rationale.
